name: When Life Gives You Tangerines
description: In Jeju, a spirited girl and a steadfast boy's island story blossoms into a lifelong tale of setbacks and triumphs — proving love endures across time.

videos.title: Spring in a Heartbeat
videos.overview: Raised by a tenacious mother, a young, bright-eyed Ae-sun has dreams bigger than her village — until an unexpected tragedy changes everything.

videos.title: Sassy First Love
videos.overview: As love blossoms between Ae-sun and Gwan-sik, they make their first bold move together. But their romantic adventure hits a snag.

videos.title: Yesterday Was Your Spring
videos.overview: After a dramatic rescue, Ae-sun and Gwan-sik return to Jeju. Soon, Ae-sun resigns herself to a sad fate — leaving Gwan-sik devastated.

videos.title: The Blazing Summer Sunshine
videos.overview: Summer brings joy as the newlyweds start a life together, but living with Gwan-sik's family tests their happiness — can they find a path to peace?

videos.title: A Midsummer Night's Full Nets
videos.overview: As Gwan-sik struggles to find work, Ae-sun worries for her family — until a lifeline appears. Soon after, Ae-sun sets her ambitions higher in Jeju.

videos.title: Life Goes on and On
videos.overview: Just as Ae-sun and Gwan-sik taste the joys of their new life, a summer storm changes everything — testing their will to carry on.

videos.title: A Fruitful Fall
videos.overview: As the village chief election approaches, Ae-sun faces corrupt opposition. Geum-myeong receives an unusual request that tests her morals.

videos.title: The Moon Wanes, Yet the Young Heart Remains
videos.overview: When Geum-myeong receives a chance to study in Japan, dreams take flight. Now Ae-sun and Gwan-sik must make a tough decision.

videos.title: The Wind Goes Whoosh, My Heart Goes Boo-Hoo
videos.overview: Life in a small apartment tests Ae-sun and Gwan-sik as they struggle to parent Yang Eun-myeong. Meanwhile, Geum-myeong juggles love and life in Seoul.

videos.title: The Storm Sweeps My Heart, the Love Rocks My Heart
videos.overview: While Geum-myeong grows closer to her quirky colleague, Ae-sun's troubling dreams stir real concerns. Do they hold any meaning?

videos.title: My Love by My Side
videos.overview: As Geum-myeong's engagement moves toward marriage, her heart fills with doubt — will her first love story find its happy ending like her mother's?

videos.title: A Glistening Winter
videos.overview: Back in Jeju, Geum-myeong mends her heart in familiar surroundings. Ae-sun treasures sweet moments with her loved ones.

videos.title: Such an Uneven Love
videos.overview: While facing a career setback during an economic downturn, Geum-myeong encounters a familiar face — sparking an unexpected new beginning.

videos.title: Spread Your Wings and Fly
videos.overview: Ae-sun and Gwan-sik grapple with Yang Eun-myeong's misfortune, sacrificing everything they can to help him. But Eun-myeong's self-confidence takes a hit.

videos.title: A Spring Every Day
videos.overview: Between new business ventures and career changes, the family faces separate hurdles on their paths — drawing strength from their bond to press ahead.

videos.title: Here's to All You've Been Through
videos.overview: As the Yang family finally enjoys the fruits of their labor, sudden agony strikes — testing their resolve and the strength of their enduring love.
